# Descriptions
@@ 1
Causes target(s) to fall into a natural sleep. This spell can affect a number
of targets whose levels total up to 3. The caster must be able to see all
targets. At the time of casting, the caster should designate target priority
(e.g., affect 1st target; if levels are left, affect 2nd target; etc.). The
first 2 rounds of sleep is magical (the target cannot be awakened through
normal means).
@@ 2
Target animal(s) will believe the caster is a good friend.
@@ 3
Target humanoid believes the caster is a good friend.
@@ 4
As Sleep III, except affects a total of 5 levels.
@@ 5
Target will follow a single suggested act that is not completely alien to him
(e.g., no suicide suggestions, no blinding himself suggestions, etc.).
@@ 6
Caster receives surface thoughts from target. If target makes his RR by more
than 25 he realizes that someone is trying to read his thoughts.
@@ 7
As Sleep III, except affects a total of 7 levels.
@@ 8
Target humanoid is held to 25% activity.
@@ 9
As Charm Kind, except will affect one target for every five levels (or
fraction thereof) of the caster.
@@ 10
As Sleep III, except affects a total of 10 levels.
@@ 11
As Suggestion, except will affect one target for every five levels (or
fraction thereof) of the caster.
@@ 12
Target humanoid must obey caster. However, he will not perform any act that is
completely alien to him (e.g., no suicide orders, no blinding orders, etc.).
@@ 13
As Sleep III, except affects a total of 12 levels.
@@ 14
As Hold Kind, except will affect one target for every five levels (or fraction
thereof) of the caster.
@@ 15
As Telepathy I, except for range.
@@ 16
As Sleep III, except affects a total of 15 levels.
@@ 18
As Master of Kind, except will affect one target for every five levels (or
fraction thereof) of the caster.
@@ 19
Target is given one task. Failure results in a penalty determined by the GM
(task must be within the capabilities of the target). If the target ignores
the quest, he will suffer the same effects as for failure.
@@ 20
As Sleep III, except affects a total of 20 levels.
@@ 25
As Sleep III, except affects a total number of levels equal to the caster’s
level.
@@ 30
As Telepathy I, except for range.
@@ 50
As Quest, except failure is punished by the target suffering five 'E'
criticals (choose which critical types randomly).
